day: Day 1: Delhi to Haridwar – Temples & Ganga Aarti
activities: Morning: Depart early from Delhi to Haridwar by car or train (approx. 5–6 hours).
Afternoon: Check into your hotel and visit Mansa Devi Temple via ropeway for panoramic views.
Evening: Attend the mesmerizing Ganga Aarti at Har Ki Pauri – a spiritual highlight of Haridwar.
Night: Enjoy a peaceful dinner and rest.
Morning: Travel from Haridwar to Rishikesh (approx. 1 hour). Visit the famous Laxman Jhula and Ram Jhula.
Late Morning: Explore Beatles Ashram (Chaurasi Kutia) and enjoy its graffiti walls and peaceful vibes.
Afternoon: Visit Parmarth Niketan Ashram and attend yoga or meditation sessions.
Evening: Witness the soulful Ganga Aarti at Triveni Ghat and explore the riverfront markets.

day: Day 3: River Rafting & Return to Delhi
activities: Morning: Go for an exciting river rafting adventure on the Ganges (Brahmapuri to Rishikesh stretch).
Late Morning: Have brunch at a riverside café with views of the mountains and river.
Afternoon: Drive back to Delhi with spiritual peace and memories of the Ganges.
Evening: Arrive in Delhi by late evening.
